source: Worked by hand from the definitions by an agent at A's instruction (task 4.1 of add-cli-benchmark was D's, handed to A). A or D should check each line. Checked line by line by Nithiish (D) on 2026-10-09.

sample.why: mean = (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 10) / 5 = 20 / 5; the middle value of the sorted sample is 3

two_point_sample.why: a resample of two values has mean 0 with probability 1/4, 0.5 with 1/2 and 1 with 1/4, so the 2.5% point is 0 and the 97.5% point is 1 whatever the random seed (10000 resamples: about 2500 zeros, 5000 halves, 2500 ones)

h1_mean_ten_but_interval_below_zero.why: (40 - 20 + 40 - 20) / 4 = 10, exactly the H1 threshold, yet a resample of four values has k forty-point seeds with mean 15k - 20, which is below 0 for k = 0 or 1, that is for 5 of the 16 equally likely samples (31%), far more than 2.5%: the lower end of the interval is below 0 and H1 fails

low_sample.why: a resample of three values has mean k/3 with k ~ Binomial(3, 2/3); P(mean = 0) = (1/3)^3 = 1/27 = 3.7%, which is above 2.5% (the 2.5% point is 0) and below 5% (a 5% point would be 1/3)

high_sample.why: mirror image: P(mean = 1) = 1/27 = 3.7%, above 2.5% (the 97.5% point is 1, since P(mean <= 2/3) = 26/27 = 96.3% is below 97.5%) and below 5% (a 95% point would be 2/3)
